field_text_formatted.value: For saves that skip validation, like a migration, drush vale:lint checks the content afterwards and exits with 1, so a deploy can depend on it. Any text field you opt in is checked, on a Drupal CMS site too. The title is a base field rather than one you opt in, and Canvas keeps its text in component props, so neither is checked.
